summary.text: William Davidson is the Republican candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Amy Morrin Bello, a Democrat who also appears on the Working Families Party line.

paragraphs.text: Davidson was also the Republican nominee for District 28 in 2024, when he lost to Morrin Bello, 59.4 percent to 40.6 percent (8,030 votes to 5,480).
